name: hub-retraction-clean
description: The hub premise supplier_K.lead_time_days moves 11 -> 20, retracted by the supplier that has standing over it. The full blast radius must be traversed structurally, scored arithmetically, and split into the four regimes with zero model calls.

retraction.reason: Supplier notified a revised standard lead time following a foundry changeover.

notes: Written BEFORE the scorer existed. Its first run failed with the cascade unimplemented; that red bar is the point.
The cascade must reach this result from claims.jsonl, conclusions.jsonl and reverse_index.jsonl ONLY. radius_truth.jsonl is the marking scheme and is read by the harness, never by the cascade.
triggered_at is pinned to the corpus retraction instant. A cascade whose verdicts depend on wall-clock time is not reproducible, and 'already closed out' is a time-dependent verdict.
